messages.subject: wake time/ sleep time example
parts:
Follow-up question: How does this math work? 

"acc_wake = waking up time according to accelerometer (+ diary) method expressed in hours
since the midnight in the night preceding the night of interest, e.g. 38 is 8am"

If I understood it right, its 24 hours from when the wake time is being calculated. In order or it to be 8 am, shouldn't the total number of hours be 32? Or the wake time be 2 pm if the total number of hours is indeed 38? 

Anyone??

Thanks
Sharmin

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] wake time/ sleep time example
parts:
Well spotted, my mistake and I will update the documentation asap.

You are right: 8am is hour 32, noon is 36, and 2pm is 38.

Best, Vincent
